embed.alt: A subversive, avant-garde 15-second experimental film exploring identity and consumption. Rapid, trippy montage: extreme macro shots of vibrant foods (melting cheese, dripping sauce, bursting fruit) seamlessly morph into human facial features—eyes blinking from citrus slices, lips formed from glossy gelatin, skin textures flickering between flesh and food. Surreal transitions: match cuts, liquid morphing, datamosh glitches, kaleidoscopic overlays, double exposure, chromatic aberration, VHS distortion, frame skipping. A person eats—each bite causes their body to flicker into different foods (burger, noodles, candy) before destabilizing into fragmented visuals. Midpoint rupture: hard glitch—image collapses into abstract noise. Rebuild: a clean, grounded human face emerges, natural lighting, stillness. Subtle breath.Final frame: direct eye contact. On-screen text appears clean and stark: “YOU ARE NOT YOUR FOOD.” Quick fade to black.
